campaign.title: The Lock-Keeper's Secret
campaign.logline: Maren returns to her abandoned family cottage, finds a cryptic note in her father's ledger, and drains the lock to reveal a secret in the mud.

acts.title: Crossing the Rotting Bridge
acts.summary: Maren stands before the lock-keeper's cottage, the rotting footbridge swaying gently behind her.

acts.title: The Memory of Drowning
acts.summary: She stares into the deep pound, paralyzed by the memory of her brother walking into the water and vanishing.

acts.title: Finding the Hidden Ledger
acts.summary: Inside the cold interior, Maren forces the stuck dresser drawer and discovers a penciled warning about the water level.

acts.title: Draining the Lock Gates
acts.summary: At the rusty winding gear, Maren uses the leverage from the note to lower the water, exposing the hidden secret in the mud.
